nameEn: Manufacture of parts and accessories for motor vehicles
description: This class includes the manufacture of parts, components and accessories for motor vehicles.
includes: manufacture of brakes, gearboxes, axles, road wheels, suspension shock absorbers, radiators, silencers, exhaust pipes, catalytic converters, clutches, steering wheels, steering columns and steering boxes
manufacture of seat belts, airbags, safety systems for motor vehicles
manufacture of motor vehicle electrical parts: ignition wiring harnesses, generators, alternators, spark plugs
manufacture of motor vehicle engines (non-starting): diesel engines, petrol engines for motor vehicles
manufacture of starting motors for internal combustion engines
manufacture of motor vehicle air-conditioning equipment
manufacture of safety glass and windscreens for motor vehicles
manufacture of motor vehicle bodies: seats, door panels, dashboards
excludes: manufacture of tyres and inner tubes, see 2211
manufacture of electrical equipment for internal combustion engines, see 2790
manufacture of trailers and semi-trailers, see 2920
